name: Abusing My Wife
overview: Scripture commands husbands to love their wives sacrificially, as Christ loved the church, demonstrating care and unity rather than bitterness or harm. A gentle and loving spirit, reflected in soft answers that turn away wrath, stands opposed to violence and treachery within marriage. God’s heart is against violence and unfaithfulness toward one’s wife, calling husbands to treat their wives with honor and love as they would their own bodies, recognizing the profound unity and equality in Christ.
